name: staffops
author: Taako
description: Staff and volunteer operations with clock-in shifts, availability, leave requests, on-call rotations, handoffs, coverage visibility, and CSV reports.
install_msg: StaffOps loaded. Configure it with `[p]staffops staffrole` and `[p]staffops logchannel`.
short: Staff shifts, availability, leave, on-call rotations, handoffs, and reports.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores staff Discord user IDs, shift start/end times and notes, availability text, leave requests, on-call assignments, handoffs, and staff actor IDs. CSV reports are generated on demand.
